Utilize and implement design patterns to enhance application maintainability and scalability. Maintain proper documentation of code, APIs, and system architecture. review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Candidate Requirements: Minimum 5 years of experience as a C# .NET Developer with extensive experience in building Microservices applications. Proficiency in SQL, including query optimization, indexing, and database performance tuning. Strong expertise in C# with a deep understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and implementing Design Patterns using C#.NET. Proficient in LINQ and its practical applications. Expertise in designing and developing RESTful Web APIs. Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices. Proficiency in Unit Testing and Test-Driven Development (TDD).
